description: Check whether an AI shopping agent can find, understand and BUY on an e-commerce store: AgentReady's deterministic agent-readiness score /100 for a host, with grade, hard-block status (capped = agents are blocked at the door; orders_blocked also covers a block the score can't see, such as shopping agents turned away) and agent-protocol adoption (UCP, A2A, ARD). Reads the latest stored score and never triggers an audit; if the host has no score yet, call scan_store to run one.

host.description: Store hostname or URL, e.g. shop.example.com

name: check_merchant_readiness
